name: mimir
description: 个人知识库：Markdown 笔记 + 资料收集 + 带引用的 AI 问答

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:styles && pnpm format:check && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test
scripts.desktop:start: pnpm --filter @mimir/web build && pnpm --filter @mimir/server build && pnpm --filter @mimir/desktop build && pnpm --filter @mimir/desktop start
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter @mimir/web build && pnpm --filter @mimir/server build && pnpm --filter @mimir/desktop build && pnpm --filter @mimir/server deploy --prod apps/desktop/server-deploy && pnpm --filter @mimir/desktop package
